Question: The election in which states will there be less seats coming to the Congress account, Maharashtra, Haryana, or Jharkhand?

Also in the just concluded general election Mahayuthi and Maha Vicas Aghadi have been very close with Maha Yuthi securing 43.55% and MVA getting 43.71%. With just one lakh vote more MVA could secure 30 seats against 17 for NDA. The assembly election may throw a different result with Mahayuthi on the upper hand and MVA coming second. But if the difference of vote share is only one lakh the result can go in favour of any party. It is unpredictable in Maharashtra. In Jharkhand the general election results are not repeating. BJP which scored 56% in 2019 general election could get 33.37% vote share in the assembly election. . Nearly 23.63% of votes have been tanked by BJP. If BJP is able to retain its base in the state, the possibility of BJP coming out successful is bright. In 2024 the false promise of Khata Khat of Congress too played its role. People cannot be fooled again and again. Hence I presume the fall of vote share in assembly election cannot be so deep as it happened in 2019. If BJP has reduced its vote percentage in 2024 compared to 2019 general election, it is more because of the promise of one lakh for every housewives. Therefore I presume that BJP will win enough number of seats to form the government.

Water problem solved in Gujarat, Electricity load shedding problem solved, prompt services in the case of natural calamity of torrential rain or earthquake generated goodwill among the BJP leadership. Also the people are very sensitive to Congress who are more corrupt and see everything in how to squeeze money out of the state. Also the people are afraid that Congress may take them back to the period before 1991. This fear has bolstered them to re-elect BJP again and again. Inefficiency of the Government is the least, though not completely eradicated. All these add upto the trust that the people develop with BJP and its government. People come to the conclusion that BJP alone can take them in the right direction and support their venture. This success will continue in the state for BJP till such time they maintain the same.

Question: Amit Shah claimed that the BJP got more seats in the recent Lok Sabha election than Congress's combined numbers in 2014, 2019, 2024 polls. Do you think it is a valid comparison?
Answer: It is certainly not a valid comparison to say that Congress party’s total tally of seats of 2014, 2019 and 2024 together do not add up to the numbers of BJP’s 2024 seats of 242. It is also not a valid argument of Rahul Gandhi that Congress won 2024 by winning 99 seats out of 543. Though it is true that Congress party’s total number of the three previous general election do not add up to 240 of BJP in 2024, to compare the result so is not required. When a party and its tallest leader has been mocking the PM on and off, Amit shah’s comparison is required to keep him silent. After winning 99 seats Rahul Gandhi has been behaving as if he has secured 99% marks where as he has secured less than 20% seats. To keep silent, such people, such treatment sometimes are required.

Question: What are the chances of AAP winning the upcoming Assembly Elections in Delhi and retaining power? Did they get more seats in the previous election?

Name: Rajagopalan K Suryanarayan
Question: What are the potential implications of BJP contesting all 288 seats in the upcoming Maharashtra Assembly election?
Answer: The potential implications of contesting all the 288 seats in Maharashtra assembly election by BJP, will be the party will remain victor in around 90 seats and short of majority by more than 45 seats. In 2014 when BJP contested on its own the party secured 27.81% votes with 122 seats. In 2019 when BJP contested the assembly election in alliance with Shiv Sena secured 25.75% votes with 105 seats.. In 2014 the contest is four cornered with NCP, Congress, Shiv Sena and BJP contesting individually. Whereas in 2019 the contest is by polar with BJP+SS pitted against Congress+NCP. Four cornered contest is beneficial to BJP. Also the situation in 2019 is different than 2024. In 2019 BJP has been upbeat whereas it is the opposition which is upbeat in 2024. Hence advantage lies with the opposition now. If BJP contest all the 288 seats BJP scoring less than 90 seats is more probable than even retaining its present position. Apart from the losing election BJP may be isolated and cornered for ever. Probably in future even if BJP aligns with like minded parties its bargaining power reduces. Maharashtra politics has been the politics of alignment since last three decades and is continuing so even now. The votes of alliance partners are easily transferable in the state, irrespective of ideology. Hence alliance is growing formidable during elections. Neither BJP or Congress or SS or NCP can afford to go solo and win election in Maharashtra.

Name: Rajagopalan K Suryanarayan
Question: Is the election of the Lok Sabha speaker challenging at present situations?
Answer: There is nothing challenging in the election of Lok Sabha speaker. NDA has 303 votes against 232 of the INDI alliance. Both NDA and INDI have filed their candidature for Speaker post. While NDA has been sticking with Om Birla, the INDI is toying with the idea of Ramesh. There is no contest. It is an open and shut case for Om Birla to get elected. The election is turning out to be a formality. The Speaker’s election will decide the exact number of support both the warring alliance have in the Lower House. Also this will be a prelude to the opposition not able to go ahead with no-confidence motion against the Government for another six months, because the Contest for Speaker will be good enough to test the strength of the government. Both Chandrababu Naidu and Nitish are with the Government. Therefore there is no anxiety for the ruling dispensation in the election of Om Birla and no hope for the INDI alliance.
